# Home Dashboard Live Crypto Bubble Presentation-State Projection Foundation

## Authority
Base: exact canonical Gate345 Binance Home Live Crypto Bubble observed-runtime composition candidate, promoted by `Kairos Controlled Roadmap Gate` #345 / run `34439420490`.

## Source-proven responsibility
Gate345 closes the released non-presentation runtime composition from Binance Home market acquisition through caller-owned Bubble metric observations. The P21 contract already fixes semantic presentation meaning for metric availability, 24h movement direction and freshness, while leaving styling, geometry and React ownership separate. No production owner currently projects one Gate344 Bubble metric observation into deterministic Home Bubble presentation semantics.

This slice adds only a provider-neutral semantic presentation-state projection below React. `projectHomeDashboardLiveCryptoBubblePresentationState(...)` preserves the exact Gate344 metric observation and each exact Gate343 metric-input entry, then derives only: present/missing metric availability; positive/negative/neutral movement semantic; and missing/fresh/stale/expired freshness presentation state.

Near-zero is not guessed or hard-coded. The caller must provide `neutralMaxAbsoluteMovementPercent` as explicit DecimalString presentation policy. The projection validates that threshold as non-negative, uses released Decimal arithmetic for magnitude/threshold comparison, and treats the inclusive absolute boundary as neutral.

Upstream Bubble metric projection failure remains explicit fail-closed data. Inconsistent metric-entry shape or Decimal semantic-derivation failure also fails closed with exact entry index. Expired remains explicitly `expired` and can never be projected as fresh/current.

## Explicit non-scope
No CSS/design-token values or palette choice; no radius formula, bubble geometry, collision/layout, coordinates, labels, interactions or animation; no React component state/DOM/runtime start-stop wiring; no provider transport, universe/ranking/Top-N/stablecoin policy; no acquisition cadence/session lifecycle; no clocks/freshness thresholds; no persistence/IndexedDB; no Your Trades/journal/chart/Risk-Reward/Calculation Brain/navigation/transitions.
